home.name: Ng Zhi Yao (Yao)
home.titleLines:
MSc Financial Mathematics, University of Queensland
BSc Actuarial Science, UCSI University · Founder, ZY-Invest
home.bio: A mathematically driven professional with a background in actuarial science and hands-on experience in pension operations, investment advisory, and process automation. Founder of ZY-Invest, a private investment fund focused on Malaysian equity markets. Currently pursuing a Master of Science in Financial Mathematics at the University of Queensland, Brisbane.

items.title: ZY-Invest
items.subtitle: Founder & Fund Manager · Private Investment Fund · Malaysia
items.body: A private investment fund focused on Malaysian equity markets. Currently in transition, with plans to incorporate as an Investment Holding Company (IHC) in 2027. Seeking a Capital Market Services Licence (CMSL) from the Securities Commission Malaysia to formalise operations and enlarge investable capital.

items.body: Participated in skill training workshops and industry talks from practising actuaries and insurers. Activities bridged academic knowledge with professional practice in the actuarial and insurance industries.

items.title: Master of Science in Financial Mathematics
items.subtitle: University of Queensland · St Lucia, QLD, Australia
items.body: The programme provides rigorous training in the mathematical techniques underpinning modern finance, including stochastic calculus, derivatives pricing, risk management, computational finance, and quantitative methods.

items.title: Bachelor of Science (Hons) in Actuarial Science
items.subtitle: UCSI University · Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
items.body: A four-year honours programme covering probability theory, statistics, life contingencies, financial mathematics, and risk modelling. Provides the foundation for actuarial professional examinations and careers in insurance, pensions, and finance.
